name: Letztermensch
body:
LETZTERMENSCH
CR 10

XP 6,400
NE Medium aberration (psionic)
Init +10; Senses darkvision 60 ft., pierce the veils; Perception +28

DEFENSE

AC 23, touch 17, flat-footed 20 (+6 armor, +4 deflection, +3 Dex)
hp 136 (13d8+78); fast healing 10
Fort +10, Ref +10, Will +12
Defensive Abilities evasion, power immunity, stalwart; Immune disease, poison

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft. (40 ft. without armor)
Melee combined glaive/gravity rifle +15/+10 (1d10+14)
Ranged combined glaive/gravity rifle +14/+9 touch (2d6 force)
Special Attacks eternal dominion
Psi-Like Abilities (ML 13th; concentration +17)

Constant—mental barrier, pierce the veils
At will—awestrike (DC 21, 70 ft.), mind control* (DC 21) (powers do not include the +1 DC bonus from Psionic Endowment)

STATISTICS

Str 24, Dex 23, Con 22, Int 25, Wis 18, Cha 19
Base Atk +9; CMB +16; CMD 32
Feats Combat Reflexes, Deadly Aim, Improved Initiative, Point-Blank Shot, Power Attack, Precise Shot, Psionic Endowment Skills Acrobatics +20, Bluff +20, Escape Artist +20, Intimidate +20, Knowledge (arcana) +20, Knowledge (engineering) +23, Knowledge (dungeoneering) +20, Perception +20, Sense Motive +17, Stealth +20, Survival +20; Racial Modifiers +8 Perception
Languages Aklo, Draconic
SQ form astral suit (Brawn x3, Improved Damage, Flexible Suit, Stalwart, Evasion, Hardy x2, Nimble; 14 CP), no breath

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Eternal Dominion (Su)

Creatures dominated by a letztermensch remain affected permanently, with the effects of the psi-like ability never expiring so long as the letztermensch and the target are both alive. Creatures are allowed saving throws as normal. A letztermensch can have a number of creatures dominated at once equal to their Intelligence modifier.

Form Astral Suit (Ps)

Letztermenschen have the ability to form an astral suit as a 10th-level aegis . Typically, this takes the form of an Astral Armor suit. In addition, a letztermensch gains the Invigorating Suit class feature of an aegis.

Power Immunity (Ex)

Letztermenschen are immune to all spells and powers, as if they possessed unlimited spell and power resistance. Their constant psi-like abilities ignore this immunity.

ABOUT

Archaic armor of ectoplasm seems to press against the creature within, as if the flexible suit was built to contain the creature as much as protect it. Two beady eyes poke out of a concealing mask as the being’s limbs converge to undersized hands and feet. The proportions and frame of this ancient creature betray a biological artifice, albeit with no discernible intention.
